app.name: Etijah HR
app.securityNote: Attendance requires being at the office, on the company network, and biometric verification on your registered device.

auth.loginHint: Sign in with your work account.
auth.forgotHint: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent.
auth.resetDone: Your password was changed. You can now sign in.
auth.mustChange: For your security, please set a new password before continuing.
auth.passwordRules: At least 10 characters with upper- and lower-case letters and a digit.
auth.sessionExpiredBody: Sessions end 10 minutes after sign-in or after 10 minutes of inactivity. Please sign in again.

session.expiringBody: Your session ends in less than a minute. Unsaved changes will be lost.

offline.banner: You are offline — attendance cannot be recorded until you are back online.
offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Etijah HR needs an internet connection. Attendance is verified by the server in real time and is never stored offline.

pwa.updateBody: A new version of the app is ready.
pwa.installBody: Add the app to your home screen for quick access.

home.dayOff: Today is not a working day.
home.noDeviceBody: Register this device's fingerprint / face unlock to record attendance.
home.devicePendingBody: HR must approve your registered device before you can record attendance.

verify.title: Verification
verify.biometricNote: Your fingerprint or face never leaves your device. The server only receives a cryptographic proof that your device verified you.

reasons.outside_geofence: You are outside the company location.
reasons.gps_accuracy_insufficient: GPS accuracy is not good enough. Move near a window or outdoors and try again.
reasons.location_unavailable: Your location could not be determined.
reasons.location_stale: The location reading is too old. Please try again.
reasons.location_permission_denied: Location permission is denied. Allow location access for this app in your browser settings.
reasons.location_spoofing_suspected: The location looks unreliable (possible location spoofing). The attempt was logged.
reasons.no_geofence_configured: No company location is configured. Contact HR.
reasons.unauthorized_network: You are not connected to the company network.
reasons.network_unknown: Your network address could not be determined.
reasons.biometric_cancelled: Biometric verification was cancelled or timed out.
reasons.authenticator_counter_mismatch: Device security check failed (possible cloned credential). Contact HR.
reasons.challenge_invalid: The verification request is invalid. Please try again.
reasons.challenge_expired: The verification request expired. Please try again.
reasons.device_not_authorized: This device is not authorised for attendance.
reasons.device_pending_approval: Your device is awaiting HR approval.
reasons.no_registered_device: No registered device. Register this device first.
reasons.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
reasons.employee_inactive: Your employee account is not active.
reasons.already_completed_today: Your attendance for today is already complete.
reasons.break_already_started: A break is already in progress.
reasons.no_active_break: There is no break in progress.
reasons.offline: You are offline. Attendance requires a live connection.
reasons.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
reasons.location_timeout: Locating timed out without any reading. Make sure location services are on, then try again.

common.confirmDelete: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.

adjust.reasonHelp: Required (at least 5 characters). Recorded in the audit trail.
adjust.auditNote: Original attendance records are never changed: the correction is added as a new, audited record.

leave.title: Leave
leave.countNote: Only scheduled working days that are not holidays are counted.

devices.title: Biometric devices
devices.explain: Register the phone or computer you use for attendance. Each check-in and check-out requires the device's built-in biometric or screen lock.
devices.privacyTitle: Your biometric data stays on your device
devices.privacyBody: We never receive or store fingerprints, face scans or images — only a public key. WebAuthn confirms that your device verified you, but not whether you used a fingerprint, your face or the device PIN.
devices.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Samsung Internet.
devices.noPlatform: No built-in biometric / screen lock was detected on this device. Set up a screen lock first.
devices.label: Device name
devices.approvalNote: New devices must be approved by HR. Maximum {max} active devices.

devicesAdmin.explain: Approve only devices the employee personally registered. Revoked devices can no longer be used for attendance.

profile.sessionNote: For security, sessions end 10 minutes after sign-in.

employees.createdBody: Share the initial password securely. The user must change it at first sign-in.
employees.initialPasswordHelp: Temporary — must be changed at first sign-in.
employees.resetPasswordHelp: Sets a temporary password, ends all sessions and forces a change at next sign-in.
employees.noSchedule: No schedule assigned — organisation defaults apply.
employees.overrideHint: Leave fields empty to inherit them from the shift.

departments.hint: Department managers are assigned on the employee's profile (role: Department Manager).

shifts.overnightHint: An end time earlier than the start means the shift ends the next day.
shifts.weeklyHint: Optional weekly target (used when the overtime basis is weekly).
shifts.formula: Net time = valid work intervals (within the permitted window) − unpaid breaks. Overtime = max(0, net − required). Shortage = max(0, required − net).

holidays.recurringHint: Only for fixed-date holidays. Enter lunar holidays each year.
holidays.hint: Holidays are excluded from absence and shortage. Work on a holiday counts as overtime when policy allows.

location.mapHint: Click on the map or drag the pin to set the office centre.
location.accuracyHelp: Readings less accurate than this are rejected. Default 50 m.
location.serverNote: Distances are computed on the server with PostGIS; the app never trusts distances calculated on the phone.

network.notAllowed: This IP is not in the allowed list
network.limit1: A web app cannot read Wi-Fi network names (SSID); the company's static public IP is used instead.
network.limit2: Devices using a VPN, private relay or mobile data appear with a different IP and will be rejected.
network.limit3: Anyone behind the same public IP (e.g. a shared building network) matches — geofence + biometrics remain required.
network.limit4: Behind a reverse proxy / CDN, configure trusted proxies on the server so the real client IP is used.
network.loopbackTitle: This browser is on the server machine (localhost)
network.loopbackHelp: Local connections never pass through the office router, so the server sees a loopback address, not the office public IP. Do not add loopback to the allowed list. For local testing only, set NUXT_DEV_LOOPBACK_CLIENT_IP to the office public IP (refused in production).
network.loopbackAllowedHelp: An allowed network matches loopback ({label}). Loopback is the server machine itself, so this entry lets any request made from the server (or through a misconfigured local proxy) pass the network check. Deactivate it, and use NUXT_DEV_LOOPBACK_CLIENT_IP for local testing.
network.overrideHelp: Requests from this machine are checked as {ip} (NUXT_DEV_LOOPBACK_CLIENT_IP). That IP must still be allowed below. This setting is refused in production.

policy.recalcNote: Changing calculation settings recalculates the current month. Locked payroll months are never changed.

fields.allow_multiple_sessions: Allow multiple work intervals per day
fields.holiday_work_is_overtime: Work on holidays / days off is overtime

help.max_travel_speed_kmh: Faster movement between attempts is flagged as suspicious.
help.risk_block_threshold: Attempts at or above this spoofing-risk score are rejected.
help.min_overtime_minutes: Smaller surpluses are not counted as overtime.
help.absence_counts_as_shortage: If on, an absent day adds its full requirement to shortage.

rolesPage.hint: Roles decide whose data a user can reach (scope); permissions decide what they can do. The owner always has every permission.
rolesPage.rlsNote: These permissions are enforced by the server and by Row Level Security in the database.

attendanceAdmin.immutable: Events are immutable. Corrections add new events and never overwrite the original.

periods.hint: Locking a month freezes its attendance figures for payroll: corrections, leave decisions and recalculation are refused.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

errors.overlap: This overlaps with an existing record.

errors.password_update_failed: The password could not be changed.

errors.only_owner_can_edit_privileged_user: Only the owner can modify this user.
errors.cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
errors.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.last_owner: The last owner cannot be removed.
errors.roles_manage_restricted: This permission can only be given to HR managers.
errors.not_an_employee: This account has no employee record.
errors.employee_inactive: The employee account is not active.
errors.credential_not_pending: This device is not awaiting approval.
errors.registration_failed: Device registration failed. Make sure screen lock / biometrics are set up.
errors.challenge_expired: The verification request expired. Please try again.
errors.no_registered_device: No approved device. Register this device first.
errors.self_approval_forbidden: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.future_time: Times in the future are not allowed.
errors.session_already_closed: This interval already has a check-out.
errors.session_not_closed: This interval has no check-out yet.
errors.overlaps_open_session: The interval overlaps a session in progress.
errors.awaiting_hr_approval: Already approved by a manager — awaiting HR.
errors.cannot_cancel: This request can no longer be cancelled.
errors.half_day_not_allowed: Half days are not allowed for this leave type.
errors.no_working_days_in_range: The selected dates contain no working days.
errors.schedule_overlap: Overlaps another schedule for this employee.
errors.loopback_network: Loopback addresses (127.0.0.0/8, ::1) are the server machine itself, not an office network, and cannot be allowed. For local testing set NUXT_DEV_LOOPBACK_CLIENT_IP instead.
errors.range_too_large: The date range is too large.
errors.too_many_employees: Too many employees — narrow the filters.
errors.push_not_configured: Push notifications are not configured on the server.
errors.auth_unavailable: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

reasonsDetail.outside_geofence: You are outside the company area: measured distance {d} m, allowed radius {r} m.
reasonsDetail.gps_accuracy_insufficient: Location accuracy is not good enough: this reading is ±{a} m, the limit is ±{max} m. Move near a window or use a phone with GPS.
reasonsDetail.gps_accuracy_insufficient_distance: Location accuracy is not good enough: this reading is ±{a} m, the limit is ±{max} m. (That is the reading's precision, not your distance — estimated distance {d} m, allowed radius {r} m.) Move near a window or use a phone with GPS.
